title: The timing strip says how long one turn of a Forever spinner takes
goal: In the spinner walkthrough the strip under the canvas reads "800 ms per turn" and "ends where it starts" for a spinner, so you can set its speed by watching it go round. Today the strip only shows the whole loop length ("900 ms follows the longest"), even though a Forever spinner now goes round at its own length, so the speed of the one thing you are tuning is never said.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/icon-loop-wt.html, data-set #tlLen=800 ms per turn and the wt-res text after step 5 ("Beside the turn length the dock says ends where it starts"). Since find-out-whether-a-forever-motion-shorter-than-t (2026-10-15) a one way Forever repeats every timing.durationMS (MotionRepeat.keepsItsOwnPace), and the strip draws its later turns as dashed copies (MotionStripLane.laterTurns, MotionStripLaterTurns in MotionStripView.swift). Header lives in MotionStripView (ONE CYCLE field). Chrome copy budget 30 chars.
acceptance: With a Forever rotation picked, the strip header names its turn length the way the mock does ("800 ms per turn"), at Next defaults
A Forever turn whose From and To are the same picture (0 to 360) shows the mock's "ends where it starts" reading; one that does not join says so
A walk picks a Forever spinner and reads both lines; picture side by side with icon-loop-wt.html step 5

log.note: Before building: the mock's dock reads ONE TURN / 800 ms per turn / ends where it starts on a spinner-only icon. The app's header had the lap field (900, follows the longest), which is the wrong speed beside a bell. A Premiere/AE user reads a loop's period off the comp; here it is now said beside the lap. Picked = selected layer's first on, one way Forever motion (there and back keeps the lap, so it has no turn of its own). Joins = angles (rotation, rotation X/Y, shadow direction) differ by whole turns; anything else From == To.

Built: MotionTurnReading (PhotonzCore, 13 tests), the header shows it after the lap field; with a lone spinner and an automatic lap the strip is titled One turn and drops the lap field, as on the mock. Walks: forever-spinner-keeps-its-own-pace-walk reads 800 ms per turn + ends where it starts, then To 300 reads does not end where it starts; new a-lone-spinner-strip-reads-one-turn-walk reads One turn. Both ok. Full suite 13,259 tests green. Looked at all three audit captures: header text legible, green and orange on the dark strip.

Filed the-repeats-label-on-the-timing-strip-s-ruler-ne (the repeats label draws over the 800 tick, seen in the audit picture). Left rough, not filed: only the picked layer's first Forever is read; audit says so.

The strip's header now reads the picked Forever's turn (800 ms per turn) and ends where it starts / does not end where it starts; a lone spinner's strip is titled One turn with no lap field, matching icon-loop-wt.html step 5. MotionTurnReading in PhotonzCore (13 tests), MotionStripView header. Verified: two walks ok at Next defaults (forever-spinner-keeps-its-own-pace-walk, a-lone-spinner-strip-reads-one-turn-walk), full suite 13,259 green, audit 2026-10-15-forever-turn-reading with real captures.
